Wonderful Hospitality, Uneven Dishes
Aug 2026 • Solo
Fried Vegetable Spring Rolls – The exterior was extremely tough, and with every bite, the filling would come out. I ended up smashing each roll because the utensils provided weren’t sharp enough to slice through them properly.

Mackerel – The mackerel was soft and tender, and the sauce was flavorful. I especially loved the finely diced vegetables served on the side.

The service was excellent. From the moment I entered the hotel, everyone made me feel welcome.

Nice Dinner On Our First Night
Feb 2026 • Couples
We were staying at the Park Hyatt so this was convenient on our first night. We started with egg rolls, we didn’t care for the ones wrapped in some sort of green leaves or rice paper. The fried ones we are used to were good. Our sea bass and rice was good as well.
We also enjoyed the bread. I had a nice cocktail to start.

We had crepe Suzette for dessert prepared table side which was the highlight of our meal. The first table we had was not facing the cooking area. Someone got up and left from a better table and we asked to move. They honored our request, and we could see the chefs cooking in the open kitchen. Service was good not great. All in all we had a nice evening and didn’t have to leave the hotel.

Upscale restaurant in the heart of HCMC
May 2026 • Couples
We had a great dinner at Square One, located inside the beautiful Park Hyatt Saigon. The setting alone makes it worth visiting, elegant, upscale, and perfect for a nice night out.

We started with a few appetizers (scallops and beef tartare) and drinks, and everything was excellent. The food was flavorful and well-prepared, and you can tell there’s real attention to detail in every dish. The tartare was made in front of you. 

What really stood out, though, was the service. The staff were incredibly attentive and professional, and the personal touch of being addressed by our names made the experience feel even more special.

Overall, a fantastic dining experience. Great food, amazing service, and a beautiful atmosphere, we’d definitely come back again.

Outstanding Service – Sommelier Thanh
Jan 2026 • Couples
I had dinner at Square One in Park Hyatt Saigon and was genuinely impressed by the service from Thanh, the sommelier who took care of my table that evening.

I went for the tasting menu with wine pairing, and honestly, every pairing felt very well thought through. The wines never overpowered the dishes — instead they complemented the flavours nicely and brought out different elements of each course. You can tell he really understands balance, not just wine.

What stood out to me was that Thanh didn’t just stay in the “sommelier role”. He actually helped guide me through the menu, explained the dishes, and made sure everything flowed smoothly throughout the dinner. It felt like he was both my sommelier and my main host for the evening.

His knowledge is also very solid — he explained each wine (region, vintage, background) in a way that was easy to understand but still interesting. Nothing felt scripted or forced.

On top of that, he’s just a very pleasant person to interact with — warm, approachable, and genuinely positive. That kind of energy really makes a difference in a fine dining setting.

Overall, a very memorable experience. Thanh is definitely an asset to the team, and I hope to see him grow even further in the future.

Disappointing Birthday Celebration
Feb 2026 • Family
We had dinner at Square One Restaurant for my wife’s Birthday, it was on the expensive side, but very average. I recall putting my first spoonful of sea bass in my mouth, to be approached one second later with a waiter asking if they could clear our starter plates. Distinct lack of care and management training. Additionally, we observed unprofessional behaviour by server staff, negatively commenting on an adjacent table with accompanying facial expressions, which made us wonder what they were saying about other guests. Again, lack of management oversight, recruitment quality. And finally, felt rushed, I’d give this meal experience 4/10.

The food and atmosphere of the restaurant are wonderful, but the service is terrible.
Nov 2025 • Family
レストランの食事と雰囲気は素晴らしいですが、サービスはひどいです。

ランチに訪れました。外国人のお客様にも食べやすいようにアレンジされたベトナム料理は、見た目も味も非常に良かったです。デザートのクレープは絶品で、目の前で調理される様子を見るのも興味深かったですが、残ったアルコールに注意が必要です。

残念ながら、サービスは非常に失望させるものでした。スタッフは無愛想なだけでなく、事前に電話で話し合った内容が全く伝えられていませんでした。温かいメイン料理も、私たちがまだ前菜を食べている間に提供されるので、食べる頃には冷めてしまっていました。電話で予約した誕生日プレートは、会計の時に提供されました（デザートはすでに食べ終わった後で、2回目のデザートが出されることになりました…）。これまでに経験した中で最悪のサービスでした。特に一流ホテルでこれはあり得ません。

ホーチミン市でトップクラスの高級ホテルの一つかもしれませんが、このレストランのサービスは期待するとショックを受けることでしょう。

Best Dinner in Vietnam
Mar 2025 • Couples
We had a wonderful dining experiencing at Square One. In the Park Hyatt, very close to the opera house, the food was creative and abundant. Service was attentive and informed. Excellent attention was paid to those in our party with severe food allergies. The best decision was getting the 3 flight blind wine tasting. Wow! No box wine here. Outstanding, premium choices were presented, well paired with the food. We enjoyed our meal at Le Beaulieu at the Metropole in Hanoi, but this meal was far better and much cheaper. Bravo.

Great French-Vietnamese Taste off
Mar 2025 • Couples
Took the opportunity to sample the set menus, one French and one Vietnamese, with wine matching. A great opportunity to experience these great food cultures, with an ingredient treated very differently but equally tasty. Overall the Vietnamese edged it, with stronger flavour, more textures and greater variation. However, the beurre blanc is still being raved about by my wife and justified a second slice of bread to soak it all up.
The wines were good quality and well matched. It was lovely to chat with the sommelier, Tran Duc Thanh, on his selections. Our only advice to him would be to brave, and be prepared to go out there with some adventurous choices! And our thanks for introducing us to Saigon Baigur gin.

Amazing dinner experience!! The Park Hyatt is gorgeous!
Feb 2025 • Couples
We visited on Valentine's Day 2025 and had the most amazing time! This was one of my absolute favorite meals of all time! Everything was beautiful from the presentation to the service and the classy vday romance touches. The menu is French & Vietnamese. We had the duck starter, salmon hot pot, pork ribs, sautéed garlic Ly flower and chocolate soufflé. Everything was just straight up delicious! Try the Ly flower - its a unique vegetable that you don't see outside of the region - tasted similar to broccoli meets pea shoots - but you have to taste it yourself to really know! The best meal we had on our trip and one that I will long for always!

Excellent Restaurant!
May 2024 • Couples
Square One, long one of our favorite restaurants in Ho Chi Minh City, is now even better! We dined here six evenings during our three-week stay. Chef de Cuisine Ninh Le Trung Hau is superb! Everything was delicious. One evening we asked him what to order for dinner and had the best fish we’ve ever had! His Sous Chef Phuc also is excellent. A new addition is Chef de Cuisine Arnaud Schuttrumpf, a French chef. His Lobster Bisque was very good as was his delightful soufflé. The service here is very good. Restaurant Manager Tran Thanh Tri is an excellent hands-on manager and very good at making sure customers are well served and pleased with their meals. Tran, Man and others were very good waitresses and waiters. The wine selection and sommelier service also is very good. Thanks Trane.
